# PracticeRx Consulting

> PracticeRx Consulting helps physicians launch independent DPC (Direct Primary Care) and concierge practices in 90 days. Founded by Dr. Ekene Ajufo, MD — a board-certified pediatrician and healthcare entrepreneur based in Houston, Texas.

## What We Do
PracticeRx provides end-to-end consulting for physicians transitioning from employed or insurance-based practice to cash-based, membership-driven models. Our services include:
- Feasibility analysis and market assessment
- Business plan development and entity formation
- Membership pricing strategy
- EMR and practice technology selection
- Patient acquisition and marketing
- Practice space strategy
- Growth consulting and scaling

## Who We Serve
- Family medicine physicians launching DPC practices
- Internal medicine physicians building concierge practices
- Pediatricians starting direct-pay practices
- Psychiatrists launching cash-based practices
- Med spa and aesthetic medicine entrepreneurs
- Plastic surgeons building cash-pay practices
- Sports medicine and orthopedic direct specialty care

## Core Expertise
- Direct Primary Care (DPC) practice launches
- Concierge medicine business models
- Cash-based / insurance-free practice design
- Physician entrepreneurship coaching
- Membership medicine pricing and economics
- Multi-specialty cash practice consulting
